title: Zestimate Trend Feed Freshness Gap
dataSources: Mortgage-rate snapshots (`mortgage:rate`), property-listing and Zestimate data (`property:listing`), HOA fees (`hoa:fee`), property-tax installments (`propertytax:installment`), home-buying milestones (`homebuying:milestone`).
app: Mortgage-rate watchers, Zestimate exports, HOA-fee logs, and property-tax installment trackers streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs, CSV exports, and personal checklists.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=property:listing
| stats max(_time) as last_seen by zip_code
| eval hours_since=round((now()-last_seen)/3600,1)
| where hours_since>168
| sort - hours_since
description: Detects stale feeds or segments for zestimate trend before a key rate or deadline update gets missed.
value: Property dashboards are only useful when the feeds keep refreshing, especially when you are comparing active opportunities.
implementation: Set the freshness threshold to the natural cadence of the source, such as daily for rate watches or monthly for tax updates.
visualization: Table of segments by hours since last update.
grandmaExplanation: It records when the feed behind zestimate trend has stopped updating on schedule.
